eyebrow: Attaching it to the alert rule
code:
- alert: HighErrorRate
  expr: |
    sum(rate(http_requests_total{service="checkout-api",
      status=~"5.."}[5m])) / sum(rate(...)) > 0.05
  for: 5m
  annotations:
    summary: "checkout-api 5xx rate above 5%"
    runbook_url: "https://runbooks.internal/checkout-api/high-error-rate"
caption: runbook_url travels with every notification — Slack, PagerDuty, email — right next to the page.
